T1_congruence_too_strict.statement: Exact geometric congruence rejects harmless coordinate deformations and is too strict as the universal identity law.

T2_homeomorphism_too_weak.statement: Homeomorphism alone can forget recursive incidence/cell labels and History, so it is too weak.

T3_simplicial_cellular_nearly_sufficient.statement: Simplicial/cellular isomorphism preserves higher-order recursive incidence but still needs History decoration.

T4_history_decorated_tower.statement: A History-decorated simplicial/cellular tower isomorphism satisfies all accumulated structural requirements.
